## Summary

Describe the behavior or contract changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass
- [ ] Mypy passes
- [ ] Repository validation passes when vault or workflow contracts changed
- [ ] Documentation reflects new commands, schemas, or lifecycle behavior

## Privacy

- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots use fictional data
- [ ] No credentials, personal career material, or confidential employer data
- [ ] Generated output is not treated as canonical source
